[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dao/Legends|Dao]] commanded '''a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''' during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], while trying to support [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]] and contact the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. After the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] were lost and the [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] was hit, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces defeated the Destroyer, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dao and his men.

==Description==
The ship had a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] equipped with [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] communications systems. There was at least one command crew pit and windows surrounding it in a semicircle. Energy was provided by at least one [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]]. The ship also had [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] equipped.<ref name="supply" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ship served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dao/Legends|Dao]], and fought alongside several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] in an effort to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]]<ref name="supply" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] from the [[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege|besieging]] [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the course of the battle, Dao was contacted via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]<ref name="supply" /> by the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]]&mdash;the leader of the native [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] freedom fighters, alongside<ref name="di-card">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_master_di.jpg|text=Clone Card: Master Di|nobackup=1}}</ref> self-proclaimed [[General/Legends|General]]<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]]<ref name="di-card" />&mdash;, who asked him to request help from the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] due to the lack of supplies. The admiral complied and called the Council, arguing that aid to his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and the ground units was necessary, since the loss of Ryloth would result in the Republic bases in the Outer Rim being cut off. However, during the conversation, the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warships]] managed to damage the main reactor of his flagship, leading to a system failure. After Dao reported that his fleet was no longer able to protect the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on Ryloth, the shields failed and the craft was destroyed.<ref name="supply" />
